test_set_and_get_approval_callback: test setting and retrieving an approval callback in the same thread via terminal_tool
test_callback_isolation_across_threads: test that approval callbacks set in one thread are not visible to another thread
test_main_thread_callback_no_leak: test that a main-thread approval callback does not leak into a spawned worker thread
test_sudo_password_callback_thread_local: test that sudo password callbacks are also isolated per thread via thread-local storage
test_interactive_env_var_routes_to_callb: test that HERMES_INTERACTIVE env var routes dangerous commands through the approval callback
